name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: One value from a long list found by typing (time zones, countries, customers): ranked matches with the match emphasised, keywords, optional group headings, clearable; the field keeps focus, and below 640 px the list opens as a bottom sheet with its own search.
whenToUse: Picking one value from a long, searchable list.

anatomy: list (group headings when options carry a group)
phone sheet below 640 px: title, search field, list
keyboard: Below 640 px: Enter, Space, ↓ or a typed letter on the field open the sheet (the letter starts its search); ↓ ↑ Enter in the sheet's search; Escape closes it and focus returns to the field
spec.motion: The list grows from the field; below 640 px the sheet slides up from the bottom edge (none under reduced motion). Opens out of its trigger (_shared/overlay.module.css, source morph): the layer starts as the trigger's own box, offset onto it, and grows; the side next to the trigger is there at once so the nearest rows read within the ruled 90 ms, the far side settles by ~200 ms, content fades in over 90 ms; it closes back into the trigger in 180 ms. Until it has grown the press that opened it cannot land on a row. Reduced motion: it appears. One highlight plate glides between options for the arrow keys and the pointer, and appears in place when the query changes.

props.name: options
props.type: { value, label, description?, keywords?, icon?, disabled?, group? }[]
props.description: `group` puts a heading where the group changes (in the given order) while the list is unsearched; searching ranks flat, finds a group's name and shows it beside each row's description.

props.name: sheetTitle
props.description: Heading of the bottom sheet below 640 px. Default: the label.

props.name: style / className
props.description: Visual field root; native props and ref remain on the native control.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Documented field and control part classes; cannot replace refs, handlers or aria wiring.

spec.appearance: Uses the canonical nearest-scope portal host. A managed scope with a pending host waits to mount overlay content; no-provider use retains the library default destination. Appearance changes reuse the same host and preserve existing state.

scopeDefaults.precedence: Instance prop, then nearest UIRoot.defaults entry, then existing component fallback. Only presentation keys are accepted; values, callbacks and operational state remain caller-owned.

spec.responsive: Below 640 px of viewport the field is a read-only opener (no on-screen keyboard under a popover) and the list opens in BottomSheet at full height with a search field inside it; picking closes the sheet and focus returns to the field.

visualContract.root: Field wrapper; className/style and classNames.root apply here
